title: Why Static Skill Inconsistencies Do Not Equate to Runtime Risks: A Behavioral Analysis of LLM Agent Execution
content:
arXiv:2610.18927v1 Announce Type: new 
Abstract: LLM agent frameworks heavily rely on external skill assets to standardize tool usage, encode operational workflows, and supply executable runtime resources. Despite their widespread adoption, multi-component skill packages frequently suffer from cross-artifact inconsistencies, where documentation, scripts, and configuration files specify conflicting behavioral constraints. Although static auditing techniques can uncover such contractual discrepancies, static defect volume cannot reliably reflect real-world agent performance degradation. This gap leaves practitioners without rigorous evidence to assess the practical risk of flawed agent skills.
  This paper presents a systematic empirical study to demystify the runtime implications of skill inconsistencies. We conduct large-scale auditing over 575 community and benchmark skills, yielding 1,182 manually validated contract inconsistencies. We further build a controlled evaluation pipeline w
author: Fengrui Fan, Huahao Wang, Jingyi Fang, Yutao Hu, Yueming Wu, Deqing Zou
summary_zh: 该论文对 LLM Agent 技能包（文档、脚本、配置文件）中的跨文件不一致问题做了系统性实证研究，结论是：静态审计发现的缺陷数量，并不能直接反映 Agent 运行时的实际风险和性能下降。这为开发者评估 Skills 资产质量、确定修复优先级提供了基于行为分析的依据，对编写和维护 Claude Code Skills 等技能包有参考价值。

title: The Agentic Scientist: Orchestrating Coding Agents for Automated Scientific (Co-)Discovery
content:
arXiv:2610.18933v1 Announce Type: new 
Abstract: Modern coding agents are fundamentally reshaping the role of human input for computational research: they write code, launch in silico experiments, analyze their results, and autonomously operate with ever-increasing time horizons. Despite these developments, fully autonomous research agents suffer from a limited ideation radius and myopic hill-climbing search dynamics. To bridge this gap, we introduce The Agentic Scientist, an end-to-end distributed pipeline for human researchers to conduct computational research alongside modern coding agents. Building on its predecessor, our system decomposes research into task drafting, idea generation, planning, sandboxed experimentation, result aggregation, baseline and ablation construction, post-hoc analysis, and report writing. Importantly, each step in the pipeline is powered by the next generation of coding agents and leverages agentic self-verification. The overall research process is driven
author: Robert Tjarko Lange, Luca Grillotti, Yutaro Yamada, Rujikorn Charakorn, David Ha
summary_zh: 论文提出 The Agentic Scientist，这是一个端到端的分布式流水线，让人类研究者和现代编程智能体一起开展计算类科研。它把研究拆成任务起草、想法生成、规划、沙箱实验、结果汇总、基线与消融构建等环节，以弥补全自主智能体构思范围有限、搜索过程短视爬山的问题。这篇论文适合用来参考如何编排编程智能体处理长周期、多阶段的工作流。

title: v2.1.301
content: What's changed Added CLAUDE_CODE_RETRY_WATCHDOG_MAX_USAGE_LIMIT_WAIT_MS so unattended retry mode ( CLAUDE_CODE_RETRY_WATCHDOG ) ends a request at a usage limit that resets too far away instead of waiting Added OpenTelemetry tracing guidance to the claude-api skill, including setting up trace destinations with the ant CLI Added the % motion to vim mode: jump to the matching bracket, alone or with d/c/y Added rows to a mod's Input : a text field of several lines in the terminal, where Enter submits and Shift+Enter or a backslash before Enter starts a new line Added classifier_verdict and permission_mode to OpenTelemetry tool_decision events, so auto mode classifier decisions can be told apart from permission rules Added classifier_category to OpenTelemetry tool_decision events, naming the built-in rule a classifier block matched, when OTEL_LOG_TOOL_DETAILS=1 Fixed quitting removing a worktree made by a WorktreeCreate hook without asking when it may hold unpushed commits Fixed the fable (
author: ashwin-ant
summary_zh: Claude Code v2.1.301 是一次以功能增强为主的小版本更新。新版本新增环境变量 CLAUDE_CODE_RETRY_WATCHDOG_MAX_USAGE_LIMIT_WAIT_MS：无人值守重试模式下，如果用量限额的重置时间太远，请求会直接结束，不再一直等待。claude-api skill 增加了 OpenTelemetry 链路追踪指引，tool_decision 事件新增 classifier_verdict、permission_mode、classifier_category 字段，可以区分 auto 模式分类器的决策和权限规则。vim 模式新增 % 括号跳转，mod 的 Input 支持多行输入。

title: sdk-v0.135.0
content: Features api: add between_tools to thinking types in model capabilities api: add the speed parameter and usage.speed to Messages api: return a Console organization's usage-tier spend cap as a read-only spend limit Bug Fixes client: close streams dropped without being read to the end client: keep an unread JSONL response open while it is held Chores ci: speed up breaking change detection docs: describe headers on Managed Agents and telemetry endpoints Documentation api: note that some models need a beta header to use speed
author: anthropic-sdks-releaser[bot]
summary_zh: Anthropic TypeScript SDK 发布 v0.135.0。Messages API 新增 speed 参数和 usage.speed 字段，部分模型需要加 beta 头才能使用 speed；模型能力 API 的 thinking 类型新增 between_tools；另外可以读取 Console 组织所在用量等级的支出上限（只读）。客户端修复了两个问题：流没读完就被丢弃时现在会关闭，JSONL 响应还被持有时不会被提前关闭。
